methods.title: At the photocopier
methods.prompt: Someone is always waiting here, and everyone has a view. A question costs you nothing but the afternoon.

methods.title: At the loading bay
methods.prompt: A coffee, a favour, an agreement not to mention something. Only two people on this floor sell, and they sell secrets.

motives.text: {name} was keeping out of trouble, and told you whatever would achieve that.
{name} had an eye on your job, and any confusion on your part was welcome.
{name} was glad that anyone had asked, and did not want the conversation to end.
{name} wanted nothing from you, which on this floor is unusual.

believer: {subject} actually reads the values statement. Then does what it says.
{subject} stays late because of the work. Not so as to be seen. I have checked.
With {subject}, what you see is what there is. It is very awkward for everyone.
incompetent: {subject} has no idea what is going on. Nobody has wanted to be the one to say so.
Between us, {subject} has been forwarding the same spreadsheet since the spring.
{subject} is lovely. Ask {subject} what the department does, though, and watch.
practitioner: Do not be fooled by {subject}. Every kind word goes in a ledger somewhere.
{subject} has never once been in the room when anything went wrong. Think about how hard that is.
{subject} knows exactly what everyone here wants. Be careful what you tell {subject}.

high: When something really gets decided, {subject} has usually decided it already.
Forget the chart. People check with {subject} first.
If {subject} says no, it does not matter who said yes.
low: {subject} is not in the conversations you think {subject} is in.
Nobody will tell you this, but {subject} has no say in anything that matters.
People nod at {subject}, then go and ask someone else.

fact: You did not hear this from me. {fact}

true.label: True
true.note: It was so. Whether that did you any good is another matter.

mistaken.label: Mistaken
mistaken.note: Your source believed every word of it.

outOfDate.label: Out of date
outOfDate.note: It was so, two reorganisations ago.

false.label: Deliberately false
false.note: Your source knew otherwise, and chose this.
